slot.brief: Give y(x,t) = A sin(kx − ωt + φ) and ask for amplitude, wavelength, frequency and wave speed by matching with the standard form.

stem: A travelling wave is described by $y(x,t)=0.04\sin(4\pi x-20\pi t+\pi/3)$, where $x$ and $y$ are in metres and $t$ is in seconds. What are its amplitude, wavelength, frequency and speed, respectively?

verdicts.working: From y=A sin(kx−ωt+φ): A=0.04 m, λ=2π/(4π)=0.5 m, f=20π/(2π)=10 Hz, and v=ω/k=5 m s⁻¹.

working:
$A=0.04\ \text{m},\quad k=4\pi\ \text{m}^{-1},\quad \omega=20\pi\ \text{s}^{-1}$.
$\lambda=\dfrac{2\pi}{k}=0.5\ \text{m},\quad f=\dfrac{\omega}{2\pi}=10\ \text{Hz},\quad v=\dfrac{\omega}{k}=5\ \text{m s}^{-1}$. Independent check: From y=A sin(kx−ωt+φ): A=0.04 m, λ=2π/(4π)=0.5 m, f=20π/(2π)=10 Hz, and v=ω/k=5 m s⁻¹.
solution:
Comparing with $y=A\sin(kx-\omega t+\phi)$ gives $A=0.04\,\text{m}$, $k=4\pi\,\text{m}^{-1}$ and $\omega=20\pi\,\text{s}^{-1}$.
$$\lambda=\frac{2\pi}{k}=0.5\,\text{m},\qquad f=\frac{\omega}{2\pi}=10\,\text{Hz},\qquad v=\frac{\omega}{k}=5\,\text{m s}^{-1}$$
